name: Start Anywhere
line: A calm search product: a large search field and six starting points beside a mist tile holding the ego network of whatever you choose (established links on an inner ring, suspected links outside it, the next links out as a faint halo, names in two quiet callout columns); the signature moment is the smooth re-centring when you pick another node, and the story steps through Aspartame, Processed meat and Lung cancer before the lesson.
notes: Choosing a node anywhere (search, a starting point, a ring node, a halo dot, or a name in the entry card) moves it to the centre and opens its entry, so the visitor can walk the web one step at a time. The hero centre is Tobacco smoking; in the lesson step Processed meat is lit in the halo around it. On phones the callout columns are dropped, the centre's name moves to a title at the top of the tile and the starting points scroll sideways in one line. Golos Text includes Cyrillic. The IARC group colours appear only on dots, always with a text label.
